en: Do I look to you like I cast spells?  Well, I did hear that Cain Firesong was hanging out on the upstairs landing of the Gallows' End Tavern at the southeast end of town.  Odd how he just stands there outside of Gretchen's room like that.
Nothing will stop us!  You will die!
You're not a druid!
A thousand more like him exist. Ten thousand. Should one fall, another will rise to take the seat of power.
Hmph! What a sorry day for fishin' this is going to be. Ah well, a bad day fishin' is better then a good day workin'.
Let's go before they find out I'm free!
Well, now or never I suppose. Remember, once we get to the road safely, return to Terenthis to let him know we escaped.
We must not give up!
Fight!
The Stonehearth Graveyard is under attack!  If left unchecked, the Alliance will capture it!
If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...
You can find the gryphon master on the northeast rampart overlooking the Valley of Heroes.
Looks dead to me. Not much use to us like this. You'd better go back and tell Krog what happened.
Tasty drinks for sale!  Quench your thirst on some of the Darkmoon Faire's finest brews!
If you're here to be trained in the tactics and strategy of hunting, you've come to the right place!
%s rushes to the aid of Feugen!
Where are your manners, brother. Let us properly welcome our guests.
Cloth is okay. Personally I prefer to work with human skin.
Metal, as with all things, should be used in balance with nature.  Karn Stonehoof has a smithy setup near the pond on the lower rise.  Seek out his wisdom.
Hail, $c!  Welcome to the celebration!
The air is abuzz with energy, Arch Druid. What is the status of the Forest Lord?
Having a bad day? Try some cherry pie.
I caught a fish if you are hungry...

I am an officer of the city, working in the capacity of the Undercity's census.  Since our liberation from the Scourge, we have tried to keep an accurate track of our city's populace.  Through arcane methods and sharpened mental discipline, I am able to access these records.  If you have business with me accordingly, please proceed.  You should know if you do, at any rate.
These trees are quite glorious, aren't they?
I have lost my Blade of Eternal Justice. Are you able to replace it for me?
We made it!  Thanks again!  I'm going to run ahead!
Back to learn more, $n? Come over here and show me you are ready.
We survived!

Karn says we need to listen to the spirits of the forge and of the steel, that they will guide us. I hear nothing but a ringing in my ears. Here, take a hammer and let us try to hear the spirits together.
%s whispers into $n's ear.

The humans and their so-called League of Arathor think to push us out of Arathi Basin.  I think not $c!  Are you ready to be sent there and demonstrate that it is they, and not The Defilers, that will be leaving soon?
Good thing someone here has tracking!  Look for Shim'la in the Hunter's Hall in the Valley of Honor.
<Eris nods.>$B$BThe Eye has seen so many horrors and so many wonders.$B$BIt displays what it feels the one looking into it is most suited to see.
Tell me about the Warlords Deck.
What deal?
Stormy seas out there.  The sea spirits must be restless....hic!
The orders have been given! Death to Stormpike! Charge the enemy!
Sir, student requests that you beat him for his lack of understanding!
You can trust any pets you have to be well taken care of by Alassin.  He resides in the Cenarion Enclave where the hunters gather.

All right now. Aside from the obvious distractions a minion like this will provide against your more masculine foes, she is also capable of dealing out impressive amounts of damage. However, her fragile endurance makes her almost useless as a shield.

Nothing like spending a day down at Crystal Lake fishing. Arnold Leland is the man that taught me. You can usually find him out on the dock in the Canal District just fishing the day away. 

Oh, and don't believe any of the stories he tells you about monsters in the canals either.
Within this circle of fire I must cast the spell to banish the spirits of the slain Fanglords.
The curing cantrip has failed. Unfortunately, the introduction of the serum into this beast's blood stream will soon end its life.
It will be done, Eranikus. Be well, ancient one.
